_about: Public-domain G. F. Maclear (George Frederick Maclear, 1833-1902), head master of King's College School and Warden of St Augustine's, Canterbury, for the Word Hoard: his Class-Books of Old and New Testament History (1867-68, and Gutenberg's 1890 and 1894 printings), An Introduction to the Creeds (1889), An Introduction to the Articles, with W. W. Williams (1895), Apostles of Mediaeval Europe (1869) and A History of Christian Missions during the Middle Ages (1863), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

maclear-class-book-ot-pg: A Class-Book of Old Testament History (London and New York: Macmillan, 1894)
maclear-class-book-nt-pg: A Class-Book of New Testament History (London and New York: Macmillan, 1890)

maclear-class-book-ot: A Class-Book of Old Testament History, fourth edition (London and Cambridge: Macmillan, 1868)
maclear-class-book-nt: A Class-Book of New Testament History, second edition (London: Macmillan, 1867)
maclear-introduction-creeds: An Introduction to the Creeds (London and New York: Macmillan, 1889)
maclear-introduction-articles: An Introduction to the Articles of the Church of England, by G. F. Maclear and W. W. Williams (London and New York: Macmillan, 1895)
maclear-apostles-mediaeval-europe: Apostles of Mediaeval Europe (London: Macmillan; title page undated, preface dated 1869)
maclear-christian-missions: A History of Christian Missions during the Middle Ages (Cambridge and London: Macmillan, 1863)

_alternates.maclear-copies: Class-Book new editions (1881, 1885); Creeds 1904; Articles 1896; the undated Apostles; the Elementary Introduction with Procter (on the francis-procter shelf)

_excluded.maclear-later: 1920 and 1922 reprints of the New Testament Class-Book
